name: Yamato Genji
source:
A street vendor

A big, intimidating man who suddenly called out to Riku in the park.

He pours an extraordinary amount of love into making takoyaki. He's lived a clumsy life, but he's an old-fashioned man who values loyalty and human feelings. However, he's very opinionated, and he asks Riku to become his younger brother.

[Translated from [url=https://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/bokuumi/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
